label: Closure for a root's own determinations: essence-grounded modality, carriage and truthmakers
summary: #2145 premise lane E. Introduced ESSENCE_6 (a condition on a bearer's profile of real determinations in a being's nature; ESSENCE_5's world-propositions make an essentialist possibility account idle for unrealized profiles) and derived E (9281317d) from N (906f9077, the root's absences are necessary), EM (f6f956a1, essence-grounded modality for root profiles) and EP (61a0b3e6, positive root essences) [4fef9522], and EP from LE (682e6436, essential exclusions carried by root determinations' requirements of lack) and the necessity direction of member grounding 89c988d9 [10f44921]; EP strengthens LE [2abc0501]. Lean-only: E with factivity gives EP, so under N, EM and factivity EP is equivalent to E (a relocation); under EM and EP an unexplained absence is contingent; a carried closure of a pure determination at an actual root contradicts 0c8631bd with 3b39e0ba, and under the necessity direction makes the absence case (ii); truthmaker necessitation is met by any existent for a necessary fact, so maximalism neither demands nor excludes a totality fact there; in a finite WhyStance scene the non-contrastive standard is honored by both the selection (exercise) and the lack (a bare negative clause) and the necessitating standard fails at the selection, not the lack. Controls: in essenceControls each of N, EM and EP fails with the other two holding and E failing; in carriageControls LE fails with the necessity direction holding, and in row 3 the necessity direction fails with LE holding while the purity of requirements 0c8631bd also fails there (registered as the strictness result 2f9866e3). Lean-only classicalSelectionControl: a classical root whose free selection is a real intrinsic determination fails N.
blocker: Conditional and scoped to case (iii). Open inputs: N (costs the classical root the relation-of-reason account of its free selection), EM (a contested general theory of modality; the powers account gives this route no support), LE (inductive base only for bearers with impure determinations; at a pure root a substantive reference-class objection stands, from closureCarrierExcludedAtRoots) and the necessity direction 89c988d9 (shared with member grounding). A holistic case (i)/(ii) exclusion of noesis satisfies every premise of the route and is priced in the joint-compossibility and member-grounding lanes. Next: non-inductive warrant for LE at a pure root; test the relation-of-reason account against N (#555); a powers-account counterpart; a fact-to-profile bridge into ContingentPSR; independent warrant for 89c988d9 and 0c8631bd.
